name: Elementa Spaces
author: makehasteslowly
description: Your workspaces as the five elements, in four traditions with their own design language: Elemental Art Deco, Alchemical, Japanese Godai and Chinese Wu Xing, each in a Light and a Bold. Hover for live window previews that scale with your screen; the element breathes when an app on that workspace wants your attention, browser tabs included. No dependencies, no network.

barWidget.description: Workspaces as the five elements, with live previews on hover and alert blinking.

schema.label: Symbol Style
schema.description: Choose between Nerd Font elemental icons (󰈸 󰖌 󰌪 󰖝 󰫢), Alchemical symbols (🜂 🜄 🜃 🜁 ✧), Japanese Godai (地 水 火 風 空), or Chinese Wu Xing (木 火 土 金 水). Right-click the widget on the bar to switch anytime.

options.label: 󰈸  Elemental Icons (Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Aether)
地  Japanese Godai (地 水 火 風 空)
木  Chinese Wu Xing (木 火 土 金 水)

schema.label: Colors
schema.description: Each tradition's Light variant (Soft), its Bold variant, or the active Omarchy theme's colors.

options.label: Soft: the Light variant (folio, vellum, rice paper, xuan paper)
Bold: the Bold variant (lapis, void black, charred cedar, black lacquer)

schema.label: Floating Preview Size
schema.description: Choose the size of the floating workspace preview window shown on hover (Small, Medium, Large, Extra large, or Off).

schema.label: Windows in the Preview
schema.description: How many windows the hover preview shows. Auto shows as many as fit your screen at the chosen size (up to 9); a number shows that many if they fit. The rest are counted as '+N more'.

schema.label: Alert Blink
schema.description: Control the fade/blink speed when an app on an inactive workspace receives a notification (Off, Slow, Medium, or Fast).
